title: Relay: the Web Analytics site tag for /traffic
body:
Fills in `CF_SITE_TAG`, so the admin page's "where they came from, pages, countries, devices" lists read gardeninsound.website's Web Analytics. The token is set as a relay secret, and the relay is already deployed with this change.

## Story

Idea: Finish setting up Cloudflare's numbers on the admin page.
Where: none
Tags: behind-the-scenes
Asked vs made: As asked.
